summary: The state is sealed to 1 reader. Attributes, outputs and stored plans are encrypted. Addresses, types, names, dependencies and revisions stay readable, so the graph and the plans keep working.

file.text: The readers file matches the store.

single_reader.text: You are the only reader. If you lose your key or its passphrase, nobody can read this state, and there is no recovery key.

suggestions.title: Add a backup reader
suggestions.why: With one reader and no recovery key, nobody can read the state again if that reader loses their key or its passphrase. A backup reader makes an identity and sends the line it prints. A current reader adds the line, commits it and rewraps.
suggestions.who: the new reader, then a current reader

suggestions.title: Remove ada
suggestions.why: Removing the line stops new records being sealed to ada. ada keeps what they already read, and an old copy of the bucket still opens with their key. Replace the real secrets ada could read where they live.

steps.text: You are not a reader once this has run. A reader who is left runs the rest, which seals every existing record again under the new key:

suggestions.title: Check the state
suggestions.why: The check hashes every record against its name and prints who can read the state.
